name: instant-worker — Redis maxmemory regrade failing (15m) [quota not enforced on dedicated pods]
description: Fires on ANY increment of instant_redis_maxmemory_failed_total. The A4 entitlement_reconciler arm sweeps dedicated k8s Redis pods to ensure each pod's maxmemory matches its tier cap from plans.yaml; this counter increments when the provisioner RegradeResource call returns a gRPC transport error (NOT a soft skip — those go to instant_redis_maxmemory_skipped_total). A sustained non-zero rate means the reconciler cannot push the maxmemory cap onto one or more dedicated Redis pods, so the Redis quota for those tenants is NOT being enforced — a tenant could grow unbounded and starve neighbours on the node. Fail-soft: the row is left for the next sweep, so a single transient blip self-heals; a sustained rate is the real signal. P2: observability/abuse (quota-enforcement gap, no immediate data loss). Source: worker/internal/jobs/entitlement_reconciler.go (Redis A4 arm); counter RedisMaxmemoryFailedTotal in worker/internal/metrics/metrics.go.

nrql.query: SELECT sum(instant_redis_maxmemory_failed_total) FROM Metric WHERE service = 'worker'
